title: CSS Cause Map
user: A frontend developer diagnosing a live layout defect who needs a compact explanation of which CSS rule, ancestor, or dynamic DOM change caused an element's final size, offset, or gap.
smallest_useful_product: Browser extension adds an element picker, captures computed layout plus ancestor constraints, ranks CSS properties contributing to selected dimensions and offsets, and exports a scrubbed HTML or JSON report.
constraints: User-authorized tabs only; local-first; distinguish computed correlation from browser-layout causation; conservative Chrome permissions.
